<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{--cyan:#00e5ff;--blue:#3987ff;--violet:#9b5cff;--bg:#030711;--panel:rgba(9,18,35,.72);--text:#eaf7ff;--muted:#8da5bb}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);overflow-x:hidden}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-3;background:
radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%,rgba(0,229,255,.13),transparent 28%),
radial-gradient(circle at 85% 30%,rgba(155,92,255,.13),transparent 30%),
linear-gradient(125deg,#02050b,#061222 50%,#030711)}
body:after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;opacity:.2;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(0,229,255,.08) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,229,255,.08) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:50px 50px;mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,black,transparent 90%)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit}
#intro{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;background:#02050b;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;animation:introExit .9s 10s forwards;pointer-events:none}
#intro.hidden{display:none}
.intro-grid{position:absolute;inset:-20%;background:linear-gradient(rgba(0,229,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,229,255,.06) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:55px 55px;transform:perspective(500px) rotateX(62deg) translateY(35%);animation:gridMove 5s linear infinite}
.intro-orb{position:absolute;width:40vw;height:40vw;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,229,255,.22),transparent 65%);filter:blur(18px);animation:orb 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.intro-scene{width:min(1100px,94vw);height:650px;position:relative;perspective:1000px}
.intro-floor{position:absolute;left:5%;right:5%;bottom:8%;height:45%;transform:rotateX(62deg);background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#00e5ff12,transparent);border:1px solid #00e5ff33;box-shadow:0 0 70px #00e5ff18}
.character{position:absolute;left:20%;bottom:18%;width:260px;height:390px;transform-origin:center bottom;animation:characterMove 10s ease-in-out forwards}
.character-shadow{position:absolute;bottom:-15px;left:5%;width:90%;height:35px;border-radius:50%;background:#000;filter:blur(15px)}
.character-img{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 12%;border-radius:48% 48% 15% 15%;filter:saturate(1.05) contrast(1.03);clip-path:polygon(25% 0,75% 0,100% 70%,88% 100%,12% 100%,0 70%)}
.character-glow{position:absolute;inset:-20px;border-radius:50%;background:#00e5ff22;filter:blur(25px);z-index:-1}
.laptop{position:absolute;right:15%;bottom:20%;width:450px;height:290px;animation:laptopMove 10s ease-in-out forwards}
.screen{position:absolute;left:10%;top:0;width:80%;height:75%;background:#071827;border:8px solid #263849;border-radius:18px 18px 8px 8px;box-shadow:0 0 50px #00e5ff22;transform:rotateX(-2deg)}
.screen:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 35%,#fff2 48%,transparent 60%);animation:scan 2.5s 1.5s infinite}
.base{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:26%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#35485a,#101923);clip-path:polygon(9% 0,91% 0,100% 100%,0 100%);border-radius:0 0 25px 25px}
.base:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:35%;right:35%;top:15%;height:45%;border-radius:5px;background:#1c2a36}
.chart{position:absolute;inset:18px}
.chart-line{fill:none;stroke:var(--cyan);stroke-width:4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:600;stroke-dashoffset:600;animation:draw 3s 2s forwards}
.chart-bar{fill:url(#bar);transform-origin:bottom;animation:bars 1s 3s both}
.intro-text{position:absolute;right:4%;top:10%;width:55%;text-align:right;animation:textIn 10s ease-in-out forwards}
.kicker{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase}
.intro-title{font-size:clamp(42px,7vw,90px);font-weight:900;line-height:.9;margin:14px 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,var(--cyan),#a98cff);-webkit-background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.intro-sub{font-size:18px;color:#b7cad9;line-height:1.6}
.intro-speech{position:absolute;right:5%;bottom:8%;padding:14px 20px;border:1px solid #00e5ff55;border-radius:14px;background:#071827cc;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-size:18px;color:#fff;animation:speech 10s ease-in-out forwards}
.intro-speech b{color:var(--cyan)}
.skip{position:absolute;right:25px;top:22px;z-index:10;pointer-events:auto;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid #ffffff33;border-radius:20px;color:#9db2c2;background:#ffffff08;cursor:pointer}
@keyframes introExit{to{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}}
@keyframes gridMove{to{background-position:0 55px,55px 0}}
@keyframes orb{50%{transform:scale(1.2);opacity:.7}}
@keyframes characterMove{0%,25%{transform:translateX(100px) rotateY(-28deg) scale(.86)}38%,70%{transform:translateX(20px) rotateY(0) scale(1)}82%,100%{transform:translateX(-20px) rotateY(0) scale(1.02)}}
@keyframes laptopMove{0%,20%{transform:translateY(80px) rotateX(10deg) rotateY(-12deg);opacity:.4}40%,100%{transform:none;opacity:1}}
@keyframes textIn{0%,28%{opacity:0;transform:translateX(50px)}38%,100%{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes speech{0%,45%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}50%,100%{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@keyframes bars{from{transform:scaleY(0)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
@keyframes scan{to{transform:translateX(120%)}}
@keyframes introExit{to{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}}

nav{position:fixed;top:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:50;width:min(1100px,92%);padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid #ffffff14;background:#06101dcc;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-radius:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;box-shadow:0 15px 50px #0005}
.logo{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;color:#fff}.logo span{color:var(--cyan)}
.navlinks{display:flex;gap:24px;font-size:13px;color:#a8bdcd}.navlinks a:hover{color:var(--cyan)}
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:130px 6% 70px;position:relative}
.hero-wrap{width:min(1200px,100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.eyebrow{color:var(--cyan);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:4px;font-weight:700}
h1{font-size:clamp(54px,8vw,105px);line-height:.88;margin:15px 0 22px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-5px}
.gradient{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#fff 20%,var(--cyan),#a98cff);-webkit-background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero p{max-width:650px;color:var(--muted);font-size:18px;line-height:1.8}
.ctas{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{padding:13px 20px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #ffffff1e;background:#ffffff09;transition:.3s;display:inline-block}.btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00b8d4,#5665ff);border:0}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px #00e5ff22}
.hero-card{height:530px;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .12s ease}
.photo-frame{position:absolute;inset:30px 30px 50px;border-radius:32px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #00e5ff55;background:#071827;box-shadow:0 0 80px #00e5ff15,20px 30px 80px #0008}
.photo-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;filter:contrast(1.05)}
.photo-frame:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 55%,#020711 100%);pointer-events:none}
.float-card{position:absolute;padding:14px 16px;background:#071827dd;border:1px solid #ffffff18;border-radius:15px;backdrop-filter:blur(15px);box-shadow:0 15px 40px #0007;font-size:13px}
.float-card strong{display:block;font-size:20px;color:var(--cyan)}.fc1{top:10px;right:0}.fc2{bottom:20px;left:0}.fc3{bottom:110px;right:-10px}
.orbit{position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px dashed #00e5ff33;border-radius:50%;transform:rotateX(65deg) rotateZ(-15deg);animation:spin 14s linear infinite}.orbit i{position:absolute;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 20px var(--cyan);left:50%;top:-5px}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotateX(65deg) rotateZ(345deg)}}
section{padding:100px 6%}.container{width:min(1200px,100%);margin:auto}
.section-label{color:var(--cyan);letter-spacing:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.section-title{font-size:clamp(35px,5vw,58px);margin:10px 0 45px;letter-spacing:-2px}
.metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px}
.metric{padding:25px;border:1px solid #ffffff12;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0a1829cc,#06101dcc);border-radius:20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:.35s}
.metric:hover{transform:translateY(-7px) rotateX(3deg);border-color:#00e5ff55}.metric b{font-size:38px;display:block;color:#fff}.metric span{color:#7f98ac;font-size:13px}.metric .spark{height:4px;margin-top:20px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--violet),transparent);width:70%;animation:pulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{width:95%;opacity:.5}}
.skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px}
.skill{padding:25px;border:1px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:22px;background:#071321aa;transition:.3s}.skill:hover{transform:perspective(500px) rotateX(5deg) rotateY(-5deg);border-color:#00e5ff44}
.skill-icon{font-size:34px}.skill h3{margin:15px 0 8px}.skill p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}.tags{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}.tag{font-size:11px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:7px;background:#ffffff08;color:#9dc1d4;border:1px solid #ffffff0c}
.projects{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:20px}
.project{min-height:270px;padding:28px;border-radius:25px;border:1px solid #ffffff12;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#09192bcc,#050d18cc);position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:.4s}
.project:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:#00e5ff55;box-shadow:0 25px 70px #0007}.project:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:220px;height:220px;border-radius:50%;right:-90px;top:-90px;background:#00e5ff14;filter:blur(4px)}
.project .num{font-size:12px;color:var(--cyan);letter-spacing:3px}.project h3{font-size:25px;margin:13px 0}.project p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;font-size:14px;max-width:650px}.project .stack{margin-top:22px;color:#b9d0df;font-size:12px}
.dashboard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}.dash{padding:25px;border:1px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:22px;background:#06111fdd}.dash h3{margin-bottom:20px}.bars{height:220px;display:flex;align-items:end;gap:12px;padding:20px 5px 0}.bar{flex:1;border-radius:7px 7px 2px 2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--cyan),#1762a8);height:var(--h);animation:rise 1s both;transform-origin:bottom;box-shadow:0 0 20px #00e5ff18}.bar:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.1s}.bar:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.2s}.bar:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.3s}.bar:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.4s}.bar:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.5s}
@keyframes rise{from{transform:scaleY(0)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
.donut{width:190px;height:190px;margin:10px auto;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(var(--cyan) 0 64%,var(--violet) 64% 87%,#263747 87%);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 0 45px #00e5ff14}.donut:after{content:"64%";width:125px;height:125px;background:#06111f;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:30px;font-weight:900}
.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:stretch}.contact-box{padding:35px;border-radius:25px;border:1px solid #ffffff12;background:#071321cc}.contact-box p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8}.contact-links{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:25px}
footer{text-align:center;padding:35px 20px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff0c;color:#71899d;font-size:12px}
.cube{width:80px;height:80px;position:fixed;right:35px;bottom:35px;z-index:20;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:cube 9s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}.face{position:absolute;width:80px;height:80px;border:1px solid #00e5ff66;background:#00e5ff0b;backdrop-filter:blur(2px);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#00e5ff;font-weight:900}.front{transform:translateZ(40px)}.back{transform:rotateY(180deg) translateZ(40px)}.right{transform:rotateY(90deg) translateZ(40px)}.left{transform:rotateY(-90deg) translateZ(40px)}.top{transform:rotateX(90deg) translateZ(40px)}.bottom{transform:rotateX(-90deg) translateZ(40px)}
@keyframes cube{to{transform:rotateX(360deg) rotateY(360deg) rotateZ(180deg)}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(35px);transition:.8s}.reveal.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:850px){.navlinks{display:none}.hero-wrap,.contact,.dashboard{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero-card{height:440px}.metrics,.skills{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.projects{grid-template-columns:1fr}.intro-scene{height:620px}.character{left:5%;width:200px;height:300px}.laptop{right:2%;width:330px}.intro-text{right:4%;width:70%;top:8%}.intro-title{font-size:48px}.intro-speech{font-size:14px}}
@media(max-width:520px){section{padding:75px 5%}.metrics,.skills{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding-top:110px}.hero-card{height:390px}.photo-frame{inset:15px 20px 30px}.cube{display:none}.intro-title{font-size:38px}.character{width:150px;height:235px;left:2%}.laptop{width:260px;right:-3%;bottom:15%}.intro-text{top:8%;width:92%;right:4%}.intro-sub{font-size:13px}.intro-speech{bottom:5%;right:3%;left:3%;text-align:center}}
</style>
</head>

<script>
function skipIntro(){
  const intro=document.getElementById('intro');
  intro.style.animation='introExit .5s forwards';
  setTimeout(()=>intro.remove(),550);
}
setTimeout(()=>{const i=document.getElementById('intro');if(i)i.remove()},11000);

const card=document.getElementById('heroCard');
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  const x=(e.clientX/innerWidth-.5), y=(e.clientY/innerHeight-.5);
  if(card) card.style.transform=`rotateY(${x*10}deg) rotateX(${-y*8}deg)`;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--mx',x);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--my',y);
});
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('show')});
},{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
</script>
